paper_title: Uncertainty-Aware Genomic Classification of Alzheimer’s Disease: A Transformer-Based Ensemble
core_problem: Limited success of traditional statistical models and polygenic risk scores in AD prediction, and the lack of confidence indication in black-box deep learning models.
methodology_summary: A transformer-based ensemble model (TrUE-Net) utilizing Monte Carlo Dropout for uncertainty awareness, integrating a transformer-based genotype classifier with a concurrently trained random forest model, and aggregating their probability outputs.
datasets_eval: Whole-genome sequencing (WGS) data from a total of 1,566 individuals (after excluding those with mild cognitive impairment).
empirical_results: Overall accuracy of 0.6514 and AUC of 0.6636 on 1050 individuals. Excluding the uncertain group improved accuracy to 0.7287 (10.24% increase) and F1 to 0.8205 (23.62% increase).
